```{r load_targets, echo=F, message=FALSE}
closest_stations <- character(0)

  stations[FALSE, , drop = FALSE]
} else {
  sf::st_sf(
    STNID = character(),
    NAME = character(),
    geometry = sf::st_sfc(crs = 4326)
  )
}
if (!has_weather) {
  message("No weather/station rows; skipping climate chunks for this park")
}

time_window_days=365
```

```{r data_prep, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,include=FALSE}
#Note that the "addLegend_decreasing" isn't quite right, but might be close enough if you feel strongly about the ordering

addLegend_decreasing <- function (map, position = c("topright", "bottomright", "bottomleft", 
			    "topleft"), pal, values, na.label = "NA", bins = 7, colors, 
		  opacity = 0.5, labels = NULL, labFormat = labelFormat(), 
		  title = NULL, className = "info legend", layerId = NULL, 
		  group = NULL, data = getMapData(map), decreasing = FALSE) {
	position <- match.arg(position)
	type <- "unknown"
	na.color <- NULL
	extra <- NULL
	if (!missing(pal)) {
		if (!missing(colors)) 
			stop("You must provide either 'pal' or 'colors' (not both)")
		if (missing(title) && inherits(values, "formula")) 
			title <- deparse(values[[2]])
		values <- evalFormula(values, data)
		type <- attr(pal, "colorType", exact = TRUE)
		args <- attr(pal, "colorArgs", exact = TRUE)
		na.color <- args$na.color
		if (!is.null(na.color) && col2rgb(na.color, alpha = TRUE)[[4]] == 
		    0) {
			na.color <- NULL
		}
		if (type != "numeric" && !missing(bins)) 
			warning("'bins' is ignored because the palette type is not numeric")
		if (type == "numeric") {
			cuts <- if (length(bins) == 1) 
				pretty(values, bins)
			else bins	
			
			if (length(bins) > 2) 
				if (!all(abs(diff(bins, differences = 2)) <= 
				         sqrt(.Machine$double.eps))) 
					stop("The vector of breaks 'bins' must be equally spaced")
			n <- length(cuts)
			r <- range(values, na.rm = TRUE)
			cuts <- cuts[cuts >= r[1] & cuts <= r[2]]
			n <- length(cuts)
			p <- (cuts - r[1])/(r[2] - r[1])
			extra <- list(p_1 = p[1], p_n = p[n])
			p <- c("", paste0(100 * p, "%"), "")
			if (decreasing == TRUE){
				colors <- pal(rev(c(r[1], cuts, r[2])))
				labels <- rev(labFormat(type = "numeric", cuts))
			}else{
				colors <- pal(c(r[1], cuts, r[2]))
				labels <- rev(labFormat(type = "numeric", cuts))
			}
			colors <- paste(colors, p, sep = " ", collapse = ", ")
			
		}
		else if (type == "bin") {
			cuts <- args$bins
			n <- length(cuts)
			mids <- (cuts[-1] + cuts[-n])/2
			if (decreasing == TRUE){
				colors <- pal(rev(mids))
				labels <- rev(labFormat(type = "bin", cuts))
			}else{
				colors <- pal(mids)
				labels <- labFormat(type = "bin", cuts)
			}
			
		}
		else if (type == "quantile") {
			p <- args$probs
			n <- length(p)
			cuts <- quantile(values, probs = p, na.rm = TRUE)
			mids <- quantile(values, probs = (p[-1] + p[-n])/2, 
				 na.rm = TRUE)
			if (decreasing == TRUE){
				colors <- pal(rev(mids))
				labels <- rev(labFormat(type = "quantile", cuts, p))
			}else{
				colors <- pal(mids)
				labels <- labFormat(type = "quantile", cuts, p)
			}
		}
		else if (type == "factor") {
			v <- sort(unique(na.omit(values)))
			colors <- pal(v)
			labels <- labFormat(type = "factor", v)
			if (decreasing == TRUE){
				colors <- pal(rev(v))
				labels <- rev(labFormat(type = "factor", v))
			}else{
				colors <- pal(v)
				labels <- labFormat(type = "factor", v)
			}
		}
		else stop("Palette function not supported")
		if (!any(is.na(values))) 
			na.color <- NULL
	}
	else {
		if (length(colors) != length(labels)) 
			stop("'colors' and 'labels' must be of the same length")
	}
	legend <- list(colors = I(unname(colors)), labels = I(unname(labels)), 
	               na_color = na.color, na_label = na.label, opacity = opacity, 
	               position = position, type = type, title = title, extra = extra, 
	               layerId = layerId, className = className, group = group)
	invokeMethod(map, data, "addLegend", legend)
}
```

```{r identify_closest_stations, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, eval=isTRUE(get0("has_weather", inherits = TRUE, ifnotfound = FALSE))}
# Process the station and weather data (skipped when weather.parquet is empty).

    cent <- suppressWarnings( focal_park %>%
                                st_union()%>%
                                st_centroid())

    shared_crs <- sf::st_crs(cent)

                 name = stations_aligned$NAME,
               distance = as.numeric(st_distance(cent, stations_aligned)))
```

```{r reformat_to_match_noaa, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, eval=isTRUE(get0("has_weather", inherits = TRUE, ifnotfound = FALSE))}

  # emma_envdata@weather_data/weather.parquet schema (§0.2 / R1):
  # STNID, YEARMODA (Date), TEMP (°C), PRCP (mm), NAME — not GSODR YEAR/MONTH/DAY.

  focal_weather %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      yearmoda_date = as.Date(.data$YEARMODA),
      year = as.integer(format(.data$yearmoda_date, "%Y")),
      month = as.integer(format(.data$yearmoda_date, "%m")),
      day = as.integer(format(.data$yearmoda_date, "%d")),
      station_name = .data$NAME,
      mean_precip_mm = .data$PRCP,
      temp_c = .data$TEMP,
      date_time = as.POSIXct(.data$yearmoda_date, tz = "UTC")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$date_time)) -> focal_weather

  has_weather <- is.data.frame(focal_weather) && nrow(focal_weather) >= 1L
  if (!has_weather) {
    message("Weather rows failed YEARMODA reformat; skipping climate figures")
    if (inherits(stations, "sf")) {
      focal_stations_sf <- stations[FALSE, , drop = FALSE]
    }
  }
```

```{r generate_climate_climatology, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, eval=isTRUE(get0("has_weather", inherits = TRUE, ifnotfound = FALSE))}

# Rolling 12-mo envelopes from the GSOD record (≥2000) in weather_data for the
# nearby station set (no invented years). Precip: true in-window cumulative mm
# starting at 0; temperature stays daily °C.
climate_as_of <- Sys.Date()
if (is.data.frame(focal_weather) &&
      "date_time" %in% names(focal_weather) &&
      nrow(focal_weather) >= 1L) {
  climate_as_of <- max(as.Date(focal_weather$date_time), na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(climate_as_of)) {
    climate_as_of <- Sys.Date()
  }
}

precip_daily <- park_daily_weather(focal_weather, "mean_precip_mm")
temp_daily <- park_daily_weather(focal_weather, "temp_c")
# Use every prior slice that meets the day threshold (full published record).
precip_clim <- weather_climatology_layers(
  precip_daily,
  as_of = climate_as_of,
  min_days_per_year = 60L,
  cumulative = TRUE
)
temp_clim <- weather_climatology_layers(
  temp_daily,
  as_of = climate_as_of,
  min_days_per_year = 60L,
  cumulative = FALSE
)
```

```{r crop invasives, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

# Empty iNat (CSV seed / Actions / API downtime): never call addCircleMarkers on zero rows.
has_inat <- inherits(inat_data, "sf") && nrow(inat_data) >= 1L

if (has_inat) {
  inat_data %>%
    filter(invasive == TRUE &
             as_date(observed_on) > (today() - as.difftime(900, units = "days"))) |>
    st_crop(y = focal_wgs %>% st_buffer(dist = 1000)) -> focal_invasives

  inat_data %>%
    filter(invasive == TRUE &
             as_date(observed_on) <= (today() - as.difftime(900, units = "days"))) |>
    st_crop(y = focal_wgs %>% st_buffer(dist = 1000)) -> focal_old_invasives
} else {
  message("No iNaturalist invasives loaded; skipping invasive markers for this park")
  focal_invasives <- inat_data
  focal_old_invasives <- inat_data
}

has_focal_invasives <- inherits(focal_invasives, "sf") && nrow(focal_invasives) >= 1L
invasive_labels <- if (has_focal_invasives) {
  focal_invasives$scientific_name
} else {
  NULL
}
```

```{r manager-kpi-prep, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, include = FALSE}
# Manager KPIs (ranks 3–6 + E1 age-class). Soft-fail so park pages still render.

park_mean_monthly_delta <- tryCatch(
  park_raster_mean(monthly_delta_evi.tif, focal_park),
  error = function(e) NA_real_
)

stress_eval <- list(
  flagged = FALSE,
  threshold = NA_real_,
  cv = NA_real_,
  latest = park_mean_monthly_delta,
  n_below = 0L,
  k = STRESS_FLAG_K,
  n = STRESS_FLAG_N,
  n_composites = 0L
)
stress_series_df <- data.frame(
  date = as.Date(character()),
  monthly_delta = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Stress series: prefer pipeline lookback target; fall back to per-park VI
# parquet pull (needs fuse + list_vi_parquet_assets sourced above). Skip in
# light CI.
if (!identical(Sys.getenv("EMMA_CI_LIGHT"), "1")) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      stress_series_df <- park_stress_delta_series(
        park_monthly_delta_evi_series,
        focal_park_name
      )
      if (nrow(stress_series_df) < 3L) {
        if (!exists("get_domain_raster", mode = "function")) {
          source("R/envdata_contract.R", local = TRUE)
        }
        if (!exists("list_vi_parquet_assets", mode = "function")) {
          source("R/get_monthly_mean_evi.R", local = TRUE)
        }
        if (!exists("fuse_evi_by_pid_date", mode = "function")) {
          source("R/fuse_evi_sensors.R", local = TRUE)
        }
        domain_kpi <- get_domain_raster(dest_dir = "data/temp", overwrite = FALSE)
        park_pids_kpi <- park_domain_pids(domain_kpi, focal_park)
        evi_series <- park_mean_evi_series(
          park_pids = park_pids_kpi,
          env_files = NULL,
          temp_directory = "data/temp/",
          lookback_months = STRESS_SERIES_MONTHS,
          verbose = TRUE
        )
        stress_series_df <- park_mean_monthly_delta_series(evi_series)
      }
      # Align latest series point with map raster park-mean when present.
      if (nrow(stress_series_df) >= 1L && is.finite(park_mean_monthly_delta)) {
        stress_series_df$monthly_delta[[nrow(stress_series_df)]] <-
          park_mean_monthly_delta
      }
      stress_eval <- evaluate_stress_flag(
        stress_series_df$monthly_delta,
        k = STRESS_FLAG_K,
        n = STRESS_FLAG_N
      )
      if (!is.finite(stress_eval$latest) && is.finite(park_mean_monthly_delta)) {
        stress_eval$latest <- park_mean_monthly_delta
      }
    },
    error = function(e) {
      message("Stress-flag series unavailable: ", conditionMessage(e))
    }
  )
}

invasive_watch <- invasive_watch_list(
  if (isTRUE(has_focal_invasives)) {
    focal_invasives
  } else if (inherits(focal_invasives, "sf")) {
    focal_invasives[0, ]
  } else {
    data.frame()
  }
)

fires_wgs_truncated <- fires_wgs_truncated %>%
  mutate(outline_group = fire_outline_age_bin(Years_true))

age_class <- list(
  pct_lt5 = NA_real_, pct_5_10 = NA_real_, pct_10_20 = NA_real_,
  pct_gt20 = NA_real_, pct_censored = NA_real_
)
tryCatch(
  {
    if (!exists("get_domain_raster", mode = "function")) {
      source("R/envdata_contract.R", local = TRUE)
    }
    domain_e1 <- get_domain_raster(dest_dir = "data/temp", overwrite = FALSE)
    park_masks_e1 <- park_domain_masks(domain_e1, focal_park)
    park_mask_e1 <- park_masks_e1[[1]]
    fireage_e1 <- tryCatch(
      {
        fp <- download_envdata_asset(
          tag = ENVDATA_RELEASE_TAGS$fireage,
          file = "fireage_current.tif",
          dest_dir = "data/temp",
          overwrite = FALSE
        )
        terra::rast(fp)
      },
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    ysf_e1 <- years_since_fire.tif
    if (!terra::compareGeom(ysf_e1, domain_e1, stopOnError = FALSE)) {
      ysf_e1 <- terra::resample(ysf_e1, domain_e1[[1]], method = "near")
    }
    if (!is.null(fireage_e1) &&
          !terra::compareGeom(fireage_e1, domain_e1, stopOnError = FALSE)) {
      fireage_e1 <- terra::resample(fireage_e1, domain_e1[[1]], method = "near")
    }
    age_class <- age_class_structure(ysf_e1, fireage_e1, park_mask_e1)
  },
  error = function(e) {
    message("Age-class prep failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
  }
)
```

```{r evi_and_burns, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# Default basemap: World Imagery (NatGeo remains available as alternate).
# Combined hover query uses true ages (not the paint-truncated veld-age layer).
park_query_brick <- tryCatch(
  park_map_query_brick(
    most_recent_evi.tif,
    monthly_delta_evi.tif,
    delta_evi.tif,
    years_since_fire.tif
  ),
  error = function(e) {
    message("Park map hover query stack unavailable: ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  }
)

park_map <- leaflet(data = focal_wgs) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "World Imagery") %>%
  addProviderTiles("Esri.NatGeoWorldMap", group = "NatGeo") %>%
  addPolygons(
    color = "black",
    stroke = TRUE,
    fill = FALSE,
    group = "Park"
  ) %>%
  addRasterImage(
    x = raster::raster(most_recent_evi.tif),
    group = EVI_CURRENT_GROUP,
    layerId = "evi_current",
    colors = evi_pal
  ) %>%
  addRasterImage(
    x = raster::raster(monthly_delta_evi.tif),
    group = EVI_DELTA_MONTHLY_GROUP,
    layerId = "evi_delta_monthly",
    colors = delta_evi_pal
  ) %>%
  addRasterImage(
    x = raster::raster(delta_evi.tif),
    group = EVI_DELTA_LONGTERM_GROUP,
    layerId = "evi_delta_longterm",
    colors = delta_evi_pal
  ) %>%
  addRasterImage(
    x = raster::raster(years_since_fire_map),
    group = VELD_AGE_GROUP,
    layerId = "veld_age",
    colors = years_since_fire_pal,
    opacity = 0.7
  )

# Permanent empty-iNat guard: leaflet crashes on markers with zero rows.
# Small green Font Awesome leaves (~scale 0.05 = 25% of post-#56 size).
if (isTRUE(has_focal_invasives)) {
  invasive_icons <- awesomeIcons(
    icon = "leaf",
    library = "fa",
    markerColor = "green",
    iconColor = "white"
  )
  park_map <- park_map %>%
    addAwesomeMarkers(
      data = focal_invasives,
      label = invasive_labels,
      group = "Invasives (new)",
      icon = invasive_icons
    )
}

# One "Fire History" outline layer (age-bin stroke colors; single checkbox).
# Filled burn polygons dropped (raster carries Veld Age).
if (inherits(fires_wgs_truncated, "sf") && nrow(fires_wgs_truncated) >= 1L) {
  fires_wgs_truncated <- fires_wgs_truncated %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      outline_color = fire_history_outline_color(.data$Years_true)
    )
  park_map <- park_map %>%
    addPolygons(
      data = fires_wgs_truncated,
      color = ~outline_color,
      fill = TRUE,
      fillOpacity = 0,
      stroke = TRUE,
      label = ~paste(round(Years_true, 1), "years since burn"),
      weight = 1,
      group = FIRE_HISTORY_GROUP
    )
}

# Empty/partial weather: skip station markers (same failure mode as empty iNat).
has_focal_stations <- inherits(focal_stations_sf, "sf") && nrow(focal_stations_sf) >= 1L
if (isTRUE(has_focal_stations)) {
  station_labels <- if ("station_name" %in% names(focal_stations_sf)) {
    focal_stations_sf$station_name
  } else if ("NAME" %in% names(focal_stations_sf)) {
    focal_stations_sf$NAME
  } else {
    NULL
  }
  park_map <- park_map %>%
    addMarkers(
      data = focal_stations_sf,
      label = station_labels,
      group = "Stations"
    )
}

park_map <- park_map %>%
  hideGroup("Stations") %>%
  hideGroup(EVI_CURRENT_GROUP) %>%
  hideGroup(EVI_DELTA_LONGTERM_GROUP) %>%
  hideGroup(VELD_AGE_GROUP)

if (isTRUE(has_focal_invasives)) {
  park_map <- park_map %>% hideGroup("Invasives (new)")
}

# EVI children stay consecutive so the injected "EVI" header groups them.
overlay_groups <- c(
  "Park",
  "Stations",
  EVI_CURRENT_GROUP,
  EVI_DELTA_MONTHLY_GROUP,
  EVI_DELTA_LONGTERM_GROUP,
  VELD_AGE_GROUP,
  FIRE_HISTORY_GROUP
)
if (isTRUE(has_focal_invasives)) {
  overlay_groups <- c(overlay_groups, "Invasives (new)")
}

# Legends carry `group` so each shows/hides with its overlay (avoids stacking).
park_map <- park_map %>%
  leaflet::addLegend(
    position = "topright",
    pal = delta_evi_pal,
    values = ~values(monthly_delta_evi.tif),
    opacity = 1,
    title = "\u0394EVI<br/>(monthly)",
    group = EVI_DELTA_MONTHLY_GROUP
  ) %>%
  leaflet::addLegend(
    position = "topright",
    pal = delta_evi_pal,
    values = ~values(delta_evi.tif),
    opacity = 1,
    title = "\u0394EVI<br/>(long term)",
    group = EVI_DELTA_LONGTERM_GROUP
  ) %>%
  leaflet::addLegend(
    position = "topright",
    pal = evi_pal,
    values = ~values(raster::raster(most_recent_evi.tif)),
    opacity = 1,
    title = "EVI<br/>(current)",
    group = EVI_CURRENT_GROUP
  ) %>%
  addLegend_decreasing(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = years_since_fire_pal,
    values = c(0, 20),
    title = "Veld age<br/>(years)",
    opacity = 1,
    decreasing = TRUE,
    group = VELD_AGE_GROUP
  ) %>%
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("World Imagery", "NatGeo"),
    overlayGroups = overlay_groups,
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE),
    position = "topleft"
  ) %>%
  fitBounds(bbox[1], bbox[2], bbox[3], bbox[4])

# One combined hover tooltip (EVI + deltas + true years since fire).
if (!is.null(park_query_brick)) {
  park_map <- tryCatch(
    {
      park_map %>%
        leafem::addImageQuery(
          park_query_brick,
          type = "mousemove",
          layerId = "evi_current",
          project = TRUE,
          digits = 3,
          position = "bottomleft",
          prefix = ""
        )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      message("addImageQuery failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
      park_map
    }
  )
}

park_map %>%
  htmlwidgets::onRender(park_map_evi_group_header_js()) %>%
  htmlwidgets::onRender(park_map_tooltip_format_js())

```

Figure 1. Leaflet map with World Imagery as the default basemap. Overlays include an **EVI** group (**EVI (current)**, **ΔEVI (monthly)**, **ΔEVI (long term)**), the continuous **Veld Age (years)** raster, burn outlines in a single **Fire History** layer (age-bin stroke colors), and recent invasive species records (small green leaves). A combined hover tooltip reports current EVI, monthly and long-term ΔEVI, and years since last known fire under the cursor (NA as —). Multi-sensor EVI uses a VIIRS→Terra→Aqua fill (NOAA-20 → S-NPP → Terra → Aqua; first non-NA wins). NA in EVI / delta layers means all available sensors were missing after QA (e.g. water, cloud, snow). Monthly delta EVI is the fused latest composite minus the fuse-then-mean for the same calendar month; long-term delta uses the fuse-then-mean over all available composite dates. EVI data are from `r most_recent_evi_date` (STAC multi-sensor COGs). Fire age is derived from [`fireage_current.tif`](https://github.com/eco-emma/emma_envdata/releases/download/fireage/fireage_current.tif). The veld-age color scale is truncated at 20 years for readability (0 light → 20+ dark); the hover tooltip uses true ages. Right-censored / never-burned pixels are not collapsed to age 20 (see Fig. 2). Each legend appears only while its matching overlay is toggled on.

## Area burned and vegetation ages

```{r vegetation ages over time, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

# Subset park_fire_history to the focal park by domain pid.
  # park_fire_history$cellID is an alias for pid (see get_fire_history()).
  # terra::extract(..., cells = TRUE) returns cell indices (1…ncell), which do
  # not match pid — that join yields 0 rows and empty Fig. 2 site-wide.

  if (!exists("get_domain_raster", mode = "function")) {
    source("R/envdata_contract.R", local = TRUE)
  }
  domain <- get_domain_raster(dest_dir = "data/temp", overwrite = FALSE)
  pid_layer <- if ("pid" %in% names(domain)) domain[["pid"]] else domain[[1]]
  focal_pids <- unique(stats::na.omit(
    terra::extract(
      x = pid_layer,
      y = terra::vect(focal_park),
      touches = TRUE
    )[[2]]
  ))

  # ~500 m domain cells → hectares (EPSG:9221 metres)
  cell_ha <- as.numeric(
    terra::cellSize(most_recent_evi.tif, unit = "ha")[1]
  )
  if (!is.finite(cell_ha) || cell_ha <= 0) {
    cell_ha <- prod(terra::res(most_recent_evi.tif)) / 1e4
  }

  # Keep age + censor fields. fire_count == 0 / NA last_burn_date ⇒ right-censored
  # (envdata lower-bounds age at record start 2000-01-01). Do not collapse to 20.

  park_fire_history_focal <- park_fire_history %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$cellID %in% focal_pids)

  if (!"last_burn_date" %in% names(park_fire_history_focal)) {
    park_fire_history_focal$last_burn_date <- NA_real_
  }
  if (!"fire_count" %in% names(park_fire_history_focal)) {
    park_fire_history_focal$fire_count <- NA_real_
  }

  focal_fires <-
    park_fire_history_focal %>%
    dplyr::select(
      dplyr::any_of(c(
        "cellID", "date", "days_since_fire", "last_burn_date", "fire_count"
      ))
    ) %>%
    # Multiple sensors/sources can share cellID+date; keep youngest known age.
    dplyr::group_by(.data$cellID, .data$date) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      days_since_fire = suppressWarnings(min(.data$days_since_fire, na.rm = TRUE)),
      last_burn_date = suppressWarnings(max(.data$last_burn_date, na.rm = TRUE)),
      fire_count = suppressWarnings(max(.data$fire_count, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      days_since_fire = dplyr::if_else(
        is.infinite(.data$days_since_fire),
        NA_real_,
        .data$days_since_fire
      ),
      last_burn_date = dplyr::if_else(
        is.infinite(.data$last_burn_date),
        NA_real_,
        .data$last_burn_date
      ),
      fire_count = dplyr::if_else(
        is.infinite(.data$fire_count),
        NA_real_,
        .data$fire_count
      ),
      censored = is.na(.data$last_burn_date) |
        (!is.na(.data$fire_count) & .data$fire_count <= 0)
    )

  if (nrow(focal_fires) == 0) {
    fire_dates <- unique(park_fire_history$date)
    if (length(fire_dates) < 1L) {
      fire_dates <- as.Date(character())
    }
    focal_fires <- expand.grid(
      cellID = focal_pids,
      date = fire_dates,
      days_since_fire = NA_real_,
      last_burn_date = NA_real_,
      fire_count = NA_real_,
      censored = TRUE,
      KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }

  # True ages for known burns only (no unknown→20 collapse)
  ff2 <- focal_fires %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      years_since_fire = .data$days_since_fire / 365.25,
      date = lubridate::as_date(.data$date),
      year = lubridate::year(.data$date)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      years_since_fire = dplyr::if_else(
        is.na(.data$years_since_fire) | .data$years_since_fire < 0,
        NA_real_,
        .data$years_since_fire
      )
    )

  censored_summary <- ff2 %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$year) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n = dplyr::n(),
      n_censored = sum(.data$censored, na.rm = TRUE),
      fraction_censored = .data$n_censored / .data$n,
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  ff_known <- ff2 %>%
    dplyr::filter(!.data$censored, is.finite(.data$years_since_fire))

  # Calendar-year burned area from year(last_burn_date) on the latest snapshot
  latest_fire_date <- suppressWarnings(max(ff2$date, na.rm = TRUE))
  if (is.finite(latest_fire_date)) {
    area_by_year <- ff2 %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$date == latest_fire_date,
        !is.na(.data$last_burn_date),
        !.data$censored
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        burn_year = lubridate::year(lubridate::as_date(.data$last_burn_date))
      ) %>%
      dplyr::count(.data$burn_year, name = "n_cells") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(area_ha = .data$n_cells * cell_ha) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(.data$burn_year)
  } else {
    area_by_year <- tibble::tibble(
      burn_year = integer(),
      n_cells = integer(),
      area_ha = numeric()
    )
  }

  # Shared calendar-year x-axis for barplot, ridgeline, and censored strip.
  year_candidates <- c(
    ff_known$year,
    censored_summary$year,
    area_by_year$burn_year
  )
  year_candidates <- year_candidates[is.finite(year_candidates)]
  if (length(year_candidates) >= 1L) {
    year_lo <- as.integer(min(year_candidates))
    year_hi <- as.integer(max(year_candidates))
  } else {
    year_lo <- NA_integer_
    year_hi <- NA_integer_
  }
  # Shared continuous calendar-year x-axis (ridgeline uses numeric year +
  # coord_flip so year ticks line up with the barplot and censored strip).
  if (is.finite(year_lo) && is.finite(year_hi) && year_lo <= year_hi) {
    year_breaks <- seq(year_lo, year_hi, by = 1L)
    year_limits <- c(year_lo - 0.5, year_hi + 0.5)
  } else {
    year_breaks <- integer()
    year_limits <- NULL
  }
  shared_year_x <- function(p) {
    if (is.null(year_limits) || !inherits(p, "ggplot")) {
      return(p)
    }
    p +
      scale_x_continuous(
        limits = year_limits,
        breaks = year_breaks,
        expand = c(0.01, 0)
      )
  }
  shared_panel_theme <- theme(
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(4, 8, 2, 8)
  )

  if (nrow(ff_known) >= 1L && !is.null(year_limits)) {
    ff_known <- ff_known %>%
      dplyr::mutate(year = as.numeric(.data$year))
    p1 <- ggplot(
      ff_known,
      mapping = aes(
        x = years_since_fire,
        y = year,
        group = year,
        fill = after_stat(x)
      )
    ) +
      ggridges::geom_density_ridges_gradient(
        rel_min_height = 0.01,
        scale = 0.9
      ) +
      labs(fill = "Age") +
      xlab("Vegetation age (years, known burns)") +
      ylab(NULL) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(legend.position = "none") +
      shared_panel_theme +
      scale_y_continuous(
        limits = year_limits,
        breaks = year_breaks,
        expand = c(0.01, 0)
      ) +
      coord_flip()
  } else {
    p1 <- ggplot() +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = 0.5,
        y = 0.5,
        label = "No known-burn age records in this window"
      ) +
      theme_void()
  }

  if (nrow(area_by_year) < 1L || sum(area_by_year$n_cells, na.rm = TRUE) < 1L) {
    p_burnedarea <- ggplot() +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = 0.5,
        y = 0.5,
        label = "No burns recorded in this window"
      ) +
      theme_void() +
      ggtitle("Area burned (calendar year)")
  } else {
    p_burnedarea <- ggplot(
      area_by_year,
      aes(x = burn_year, y = area_ha)
    ) +
      geom_col(width = 0.8, fill = "firebrick") +
      ylab("Area burned (ha)") +
      xlab(NULL) +
      theme_bw() +
      shared_panel_theme +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
      ggtitle("Area burned (calendar year of last burn)")
    p_burnedarea <- shared_year_x(p_burnedarea)
  }

  # Thin strip: proportion of park cells right-censored / never-burned by year.
  if (nrow(censored_summary) >= 1L && !is.null(year_limits)) {
    p_cens <- ggplot(
      censored_summary,
      aes(x = year, y = fraction_censored)
    ) +
      geom_area(fill = "grey55", alpha = 0.55) +
      geom_line(color = "grey25", linewidth = 0.4) +
      scale_y_continuous(
        limits = c(0, 1),
        breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1),
        labels = function(x) paste0(round(x * 100), "%")
      ) +
      ylab("Censored") +
      xlab(NULL) +
      theme_bw() +
      shared_panel_theme +
      theme(
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8)
      )
    p_cens <- shared_year_x(p_cens)
  } else {
    p_cens <- ggplot() +
      theme_void()
  }

  # Hide year tick labels on the ridgeline (after coord_flip they sit on x);
  # bottom strip keeps the shared calendar-year labels.
  if (inherits(p1, "ggplot") && !is.null(year_limits)) {
    p1 <- p1 +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
  }

  plot_grid(
    p_burnedarea,
    p1,
    p_cens,
    ncol = 1,
    align = "v",
    axis = "lr",
    labels = "AUTO",
    rel_heights = c(0.28, 0.58, 0.14),
    label_size = 0
  )

```

Figure 2. Top: Calendar-year burned area in the park from each cell's `last_burn_date` on the latest fireage snapshot (hectares; domain cell area × cell count). Empty panels show “No burns recorded in this window” when no known burns fall in the history. Middle: ridgeplot of **true** vegetation ages for cells with a known burn (ages older than 20 years appear when the data support them). Bottom: proportion of park cells that are right-censored / never-burned in the satellite+agency record (not assigned a fake age of 20). The barplot, ridgeline, and censored strip share the same continuous calendar-year x-axis (ticks aligned vertically via cowplot).

```{r climate_fig_caps, echo=FALSE}
.clim_span_txt <- function(layers) {
  if (!is.list(layers)) {
    return("the full published GSOD record for nearby stations")
  }
  n <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(layers$n_hist_years))
  rs <- tryCatch(as.Date(layers$record_start), error = function(e) as.Date(NA))
  re <- tryCatch(as.Date(layers$record_end), error = function(e) as.Date(NA))
  if (!length(n) || !is.finite(n) || n < 1L) {
    return("the full published GSOD record for nearby stations")
  }
  if (!is.na(rs) && !is.na(re)) {
    return(sprintf(
      "%d prior 12-mo slices from the published station record (%s–%s)",
      n, format(rs, "%Y"), format(re, "%Y")
    ))
  }
  sprintf("%d prior 12-mo slices from the published station record", n)
}
precip_fig_cap <- paste0(
  "Figure 3. Cumulative precipitation over the previous 12 months ",
  "(mm; curve starts at 0 at the window start and sums forward) ending at ",
  "the latest GSOD observation (via emma_envdata `weather_data`, rows from ",
  "≥2000 when published). Thin grey lines are prior 12-month cumulative ",
  "slices aligned onto this window; grey ribbons are the 5–95th and 25–75th ",
  "percentiles; the thick black line is the long-term median; the thick red ",
  "line is the current window cumulative. Envelope uses ",
  .clim_span_txt(get0("precip_clim", inherits = TRUE, ifnotfound = NULL)),
  ". The y-axis uses a log1p transform (tick labels in mm)."
)
temp_fig_cap <- paste0(
  "Figure 4. Daily temperature over the previous 12 months ending at the ",
  "latest GSOD observation (via emma_envdata `weather_data`, rows from ",
  "≥2000 when published). Thin grey lines are prior 12-month slices aligned ",
  "onto this window; grey ribbons are the 5–95th and 25–75th percentiles; ",
  "the thick black line is the long-term median; the thick red line is the ",
  "current trailing year. Envelope uses ",
  .clim_span_txt(get0("temp_clim", inherits = TRUE, ifnotfound = NULL)),
  ". Precip and temperature panels share the same rolling 12-month x-window."
)
```

```{r calc_spi_1, eval = F, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
### SPI

#The Standardized Precipitation Index [(SPI)](https://gmao.gsfc.nasa.gov/research/subseasonal/atlas/SPI-html/SPI-description.html#:~:text=The%20SPI%20is%20used%20for,from%20subseasonal%20to%20interannual%20scales.) is a drought index ranging from -3 (very dry) to +3 (very wet).


  #Make a dataset with only mostly complete data

  stations_to_keep <-
    bind_cols(date_time=time(focal_precip_monthly_xts),focal_precip_monthly_xts)%>%
    filter(date_time>as_date(2023-01-1)) |> 
    pivot_longer(cols = !date_time,
                 names_to = "station_name",
                 values_to = "monthly_precip_mm") %>%
    group_by(station_name) %>% 
    summarize(fraction_na = sum(is.na(monthly_precip_mm))/length(monthly_precip_mm)) %>% 
    filter(fraction_na < 0.20) %>%
    dplyr::select(station_name)

  
  focal_precip_monthly_xts %>%
     as.data.frame() %>%
    .[stations_to_keep$station_name] %>%
     mutate_if(is.character, as.numeric) -> focal_spi_data

  
  # Only use the mean estimates if those are the only complete ones

    focal_spi_data %>%
    dplyr::select(!mean) -> focal_spi_data
```

```{r, echo=F, results='asis'}
# build table of dates when products were last updated

weather_updated <- if (isTRUE(has_weather) &&
                       is.data.frame(focal_weather) &&
                       "date_time" %in% names(focal_weather) &&
                       nrow(focal_weather) > 0L) {
  format(max(focal_weather$date_time, na.rm = TRUE), "%Y-%b-%d")
} else {
  "unavailable"
}
dates <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(Description = "Website", Date = format(now(), "%Y-%b-%d")),
  data.frame(
    Description = "EVI (VIIRS→Terra→Aqua fill)",
    Date = format(most_recent_evi_date, "%Y-%b-%d")
```
